verdict.rationale: n8n's source is publicly readable on GitHub, and the self-hosted version is published there (n8n-gh-2, n8n-docs-29). However, the license is the fair-code Sustainable Use License or Enterprise License (n8n-docs-12, n8n-docs-30), not an OSI-approved open license, and a community user notes it is 'source-available… Not really OSS' (n8n-comm-19). Missing for 10: an OSI-approved open-source license, and documentation of what the Sustainable Use License permits or restricts for reading, modifying, and redistributing the code.
